big: A client asks, 'Should I buy defence because of the news?' A good RM does not lead with war headlines. Lead with structure: budgets, indigenisation and exports.

lines: Lead with structure. Always state the risks: valuation, execution and the government as the dominant customer. Defence suits high-risk, long-horizon investors as a 5 to 10% satellite. Prefer staggered entry and an annual review.

rows: valuation, execution, government as main customer
